review: Every shot shows the perspective overhead camera or first person from the runtime commit; no orthographic frames remain.
The Vac Cam shot shows the goggle change, a first-person drone kill with tracers and the goggles closing back to the top view.
Aisle 24 shows key beams, a lit red door and the green-key route; SHELF CONTROL, the Foreman and an earned upgrade card appear.
Captions and end card are legible at 1280x720; the soundtrack is the unchanged Atlas creation.
